ownership_review.controller_probe: One private WorkerPool slot, one bounded watch command slot and two request tokens. The original session returns an error after cancellation. Explicit shutdown and exact Completion observation precede probe exit; the second token still pending demonstrates an acknowledgement defect, not native worker leakage.
ownership_review.color_probe: One synthetic 160x120 frame; each subprocess is waited and its captured buffers reclaimed. No hardware, persistent service or user video is opened.
ownership_review.android: Startup callback leases and reverse-order cleanup exist, but closure return and native onClosed are conflated during same-process retry. Outer worker retirement does not supply an internal retry fence.
ownership_review.leak_result: No new unbounded leak confirmed in inspected paths; no comprehensive leak-freedom, native safety or whole-repository coverage claim.

limits: No running Blent process was controlled or signalled. No installation, ADB action, live device access or push.
Existing tests do not cover the reported counterexamples. Required permanent regression coverage is recorded with each TODO.
Android results use Robolectric, not native hardware. Physical camera color/brightness acceptance remains T1452.
No per-function production coverage was remeasured in this review; production code is unchanged.
